anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: He bears our sins and is in pain for us.
By his bruise we were healed.
By his bruise you were healed.

pass_a_gloss: For his death did not come to be from sin, but he himself bears our sins and is in pain about us, and by his bruise we all were healed.
pass_b_english: For his death did not come from sin, but he himself bears our sins and is in pain for us, and by his bruise we all were healed (Isaiah 53:4) (Isaiah 53:5) (1 Peter 2:24).
source_text: Καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἐξ ἁμαρτίας ἐγένετο αὐτοῦ ὁ θάνατος, ἀλλὰ αὐτὸς τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν φέρει καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν ὀδυνᾶται, καὶ τῷ μώλωπι αὐτοῦ πάντες ἡμεῖς ἰάθημεν.
